title: The European tour and the Paris hold-up
summary: The tour went from London to Paris, Geneva and Switzerland; robbers held up the Paris show but the receipts were recovered.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: right. So then when we got to New York, we all met (unintelligible) had to put somebody to keep up with it, you know. So put everything in Little Brother's hands and kept us together, said, "All you all keep behind -- keep -- you know, watch me." So we got (unintelligible) all got together, got in the car and everything. So they say, my manager was named Mickey, he kind of looked like Ronnie. Ronnie looked so much like him, I almost called him Ronnie. He looks just like Ronnie, Mickey do. Mickey looks just like Ronnie, like two black-eyed peas.
I went to London, that's where I went.

Then I went to London, I went to Paris, went to France, went to Geneva, went to Switzerland. I got held up in Paris, we got held up in Paris. They held up the whole show in Paris and took the whole day's receipts in Paris.
What do you mean? Some robbers held you up?

Yeah, some white fellas come -- they held up the whole show and so the manager told -- come back there and told us, say, "Some robbers at the front door. You all don't no stampede. You all keep on playing like you all don't think nothing going to happen." We kept on with
the show. They got the whole day's receipts, but they got it back.
Yes, sir, they got it back.
The French police got it back?
(Unintelligible) got it back. Ain't that grand?
